title: Seeds in Soil: Early Garden Prep
reason: Provides a detailed explanation of how to start growing vegetables in early spring.

tasks.task: Demonstrates the process of preparing and planting the garden in early spring.

subtasks.text: Explain the importance of sowing vegetables directly in the ground.
Highlight the first week of April as the ideal time to start outdoor gardening.
Describe the preference of certain vegetables for cooler weather and their early planting.

tasks.task: Show the process of preparing the soil for planting.

subtasks.text: Show the application of compost to the soil.
Demonstrate using a stick to mark rows and the optimal planting depth.
Show the spacing of seeds and covering them lightly with soil.

tasks.task: Illustrate the protection measures for the garden.

subtasks.text: Showcase the use of a hoop and plastic cover for protecting the garden bed.
Explain the benefits of combining cool crop with cover for extending the growing season.
